conclusions: An integer carried Value aligns directly with each original K16 maximum while normal scaled FP16 products use exact scalar FP32 multiplication and toward-zero conversion. A scale below2^-126 makes every normal FP16 product align to integer zero. This extends the previous supported arithmetic range without converting an underflowing or overflowing carried Value to FP32. The default earlier QK method remains unchanged.

Single-lane and four-lane projection kernels use the same lossless36-byte K16 operand view. Four lanes preserve the original subgroup max/sum reductions and canonical raw carry order. Unsupported groups reconstruct their original BF16 words and use the original wide primitive; eligibility is per group rather than rejecting the complete projection row. No producer,selector,precision,tolerance or product dispatcher changes.

Every BF16 encoding roundtrips in four contexts and supported products reconstruct exactly. Sanitizers and input immutability pass.
